prompts.prompt: Wide shot from the back of the auditorium at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern in Stockholm, capturing the full stage bathed in warm theatrical house lights before a dansföreställning begins, an audience of parents and children settling into curved red seats, soft daylight still glowing through high lobby windows.

Medium shot on the ZebraDans stage of two dancers mid-lift during a contemporary dansföreställning at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, sweat catching stage light, one performer extended horizontally while the other supports from below, blurred audience clapping behind, focus on tension and trust.

Behind-the-scenes view of Kulturhuset Stadsteatern's marble-floored foyer during intermission of a dansföreställning, children in coats running past abstract wall art, adults holding coffee cups, natural light from tall Sergels torg-facing windows casting long shadows across the polished floor.

Close-up of a young ballet student's satin pointe shoe resting on a worn wooden barre at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, ribbons neatly tied, chalk dust visible on the scuffed floor beneath, warm overhead studio light catching pink fabric, capturing pre-performance stillness before a nötknäpparen rehearsal.

Tender close-up of a toddler and caregiver seated front row at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern watching a dansföreställning for babies, soft pastel stage lighting washing over their faces, the child mimicking a dancer's arm wave, bokeh of other audience members in the background, quiet shared wonder.
